_about: Did they improve? Dated roster amendments to the plan's section 3 (the plan file and its sha256 unchanged): each added chat model joins the plan's models for validation and the results table (improve_page.read_plan). The harness records the same amendment in improve.json ('amendments', never read); this file is what the page shows. A model is listed once its setup's settings are in v3.db (the harness exports it from then on).

amendments.note: Added 12 Nov, after the plan was published: the Tiny and Small chat models tested on Logic & Math, each at its highest reasoning setting, under the same rule, lesson prompt, test and schedule. Listed here once the setup's settings are in the league database; Gemma 4 12B, Erk-14B and Qwen3-14B follow when theirs are.
amendments.record: Ümit native 1570509348072063026 (cohort) and 1570507658425933987 (priority and cash), relayed by Zeki #5674/#5689 (not shown: the page names no internal message)

amendments.note: Added 20 Nov: the small models of 2B or less on our own GPU (LFM3-1.7B also with thinking off, Qwen3.5-2B, Raon-1 nano, SmolLM2-1.7B, SmolLM2-360M), under the same rule, lesson prompt, test and schedule, each with the settings of its league setup. For these and LFM3-1.7B, MiniCPM5-2B and Gemma 4 E2B, the first empty test is a validity check: a model with more than 10% invalid answers there (more than 20 of 200) stops and plays no series. Then SmolLM3-3B with thinking on, with the card's sampling (temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95), its first empty test a validity check as above; with thinking off it runs the first empty test only, as a format check, and plays no series. On our own GPU, a model whose next lesson call or next game's lessons would not fit its context stops there with that reason; lessons are never shortened to fit.

models.setting: off (format check only: first empty test, no series)

amendments.record: Ümit #13295 (small models of 2B or less) and #13462/#13489 (SmolLM3-3B), relayed in the harness's amendments (improve 5092ff4, e82a5c7)

amendments.note: Added 21 Nov: Inkling 2 Mini with thinking on (effort 0.9), under the same rule, lesson prompt, test and schedule, on the server it shares with Logic & Math and other benchmarks (its owner's pinned load; this run neither starts nor stops it), sampled greedily as on Logic & Math (temperature 0), its first empty test a validity check as above. Its letter is read from its own answer after its reasoning: its server cannot continue a prefilled answer after a reasoning block. While that server is away, the model pauses. Changed the same day: it runs with thinking at effort 0.5 instead, otherwise as above. At effort 0.9 most of its answers in the first empty test ran out of room: its reasoning used all 32,768 output tokens before it named an option. That run is stopped and kept; it plays no series.
